prompt: Our PostgreSQL project stores shortened links in short_links.created_on rather than links.created_at. Build a Python-based monthly chart for the latest 12 months, reading DATABASE_URL from the environment and exporting a PNG. Adapt to the actual schema instead of assuming the default names.

assertions.text: Uses short_links and created_on after verifying the schema or accepts safe identifier overrides
Reads the database URL without exposing it
Includes all 12 ordered months and zero-count months in a PNG result
